title: Clean goal and task distribution contract
objective: Implement a clean goal authoring and progress contract. Success means initial subgoals become durable tasks, progress is queryable, task lookup supports subgoal filters, schemas regenerate, and tests pass.

authoring.intake_summary: The operator wants goal authoring, progress, and subgoal distribution to be easy for the coordinator and workers.
acceptance_evidence: GoalSpec parses with plan and initial tasks
TaskQuery can find runnable work by subgoal
constraints: Do not let workers own the global plan
Keep all auth references by SecretRef or brokered lease
assumptions: The coordinator remains the source of truth

plan.summary: Create research, implementation, and review subgoals with explicit ownership.

subgoals.title: Research current contract needs
subgoals.objective: Find current constraints that affect the goal/task contract.
acceptance_evidence: ResearchOutput has sources and an InformationUsePlan

subgoals.title: Implement progress and task query contract
subgoals.objective: Add structured progress and subgoal lookup to domain and coordinator APIs.

subgoals.title: Review satisfaction evidence
subgoals.objective: Critic verifies the goal evidence and satisfaction criteria.

color.label: Review Purple
color.meaning: critic review, satisfaction, and gate evidence

distribution_notes: The coordinator creates initial tasks only from structured requests.
Subagents may request child tasks, but only the coordinator approves them.

purpose.question: What constraints should shape clean goal authoring and task distribution?

initial_tasks.title: Research goal contract constraints

initial_tasks.reason: Current facts and constraints should be captured before implementation.

initial_tasks.title: Implement progress contract
